COMMAND 1 (launches the billed run detached; it returns at once; a non-zero exit of the probe with partial rows is a valid outcome, do not retry):

Run COMMAND 2 only after COMMAND 1b printed DONE. Then print the report's GATE section and say in one or two sentences what happened, including any stop reason. Do not interpret quality.
